title: Mexican Charred Sweetcorn Salad with Feta, Lime and Chilli
summary: A bright vegetarian lunch salad with smoky charred sweetcorn, salty feta, fresh coriander, lime and a gentle chilli kick. It is quick to make and works well warm or at room temperature.
steps: Heat a large dry frying pan over a high heat until very hot. Add the sweetcorn in an even layer and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring only occasionally, until the kernels are blistered and charred in spots.
While the corn chars, put the diced red bell pepper, red onion, chilli and coriander into a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper to make a bright dressing.
Tip the hot charred sweetcorn into the bowl with the vegetables. Pour over the dressing and toss well so the corn is glossy and evenly seasoned.
Let the salad cool for 3–5 minutes, then gently fold through the crumbled feta, keeping some larger pieces intact. Taste and add a little more lime juice or salt if needed.
Serve warm or at room temperature, with extra coriander scattered over if liked.
